subject: Fork runApp() for shared R session

messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: Fork runApp() for shared R session
parts:
I don't know if it is possible, but I think that having a "fork" option when using runApp() (ie the R session used to host shiny is preliminary forked from the parent one) should be convenient to share a common R session within different shiny instances.
It could be a poor-man's "multi-user" mode for shiny, which may be useful for interactive/shared/... working mode.

If it is not possible for the AGPL version, maybe a more deeply configurable version (say the paid one :) should be the target ?

messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: Re: Fork runApp() for shared R session
parts:
Hi Joe,

yes, it works but the R session is locked during a long process, so the different shiny users are waiting each other process to finish.
I just saw the "fork" of the parent R session as a convenient way to handle this issue...

But anyway, I think I can bypass this problem because my "long" process is in fact a Rserve call, so I can embed it in a java thread which will not lock the R session.
I just think this issue could be treated more generally with a fork.
